nodes.label: Reduce-Manual-Work Build Mission
nodes.rationale: Every feature must save employee time, reduce mistakes, increase revenue, improve customer experience, or produce business insights. Nothing else gets built; the software remembers everything so the owner never has to.

nodes.label: Daily Parking Pass
nodes.rationale: $20/day fixed. Expires at NOON on the end date so the spot frees for the afternoon. Renewals continue from the OLD end date so a late customer pays with no free gap; close-out settles exact time used.

nodes.label: Monthly Parking Pass (Per-Truck Pricing)
nodes.rationale: $250 default but PER-TRUCK: each truck priced on its own overridable rate, the company pays the SUM of its trucks, cashier charges the total. NOT one company rate.

nodes.label: Monthly Reserved Spot in Zone A
nodes.rationale: Every monthly truck holds its own fixed reserved spot in Zone A, released only on close-out.
nodes.norm_label: monthly reserved spot in zone a

nodes.label: Parking Pass Fields
nodes.rationale: Only ask for truck#, trailer#, plate, company, phone, type, price, start, end, payment method, notes. Never ask unnecessary questions.

nodes.label: AI Search
nodes.rationale: Biggest feature: type a truck/trailer/plate and within one second see paid/expired status, company, phone, history — no manual searching.

nodes.label: Spot Holder Logic
nodes.rationale: A monthly leaves a personal car to save their spot; when the truck returns the car leaves and the truck parks. Reserved-by-vehicle with a spot timeline.

nodes.label: Smart Dashboard
nodes.rationale: Business intelligence instead of raw numbers: revenue, occupancy, renewals, top/late payers, peak days/hours, forecasts.

nodes.label: Monthly Reminder System
nodes.rationale: Only monthly customers get reminders at 7/3/1 days before and on expiration day; friendly, professional, no spam.

nodes.label: AI Sales Opportunities
nodes.rationale: Convert frequent daily/weekly visitors into monthly plans; surface hot/warm/cold leads automatically.

nodes.label: Payment History
nodes.rationale: Every payment stored, never deleted: receipt, method, employee, amount, notes, date.

nodes.label: Audit Log
nodes.rationale: Everything tracked: created, edited, renewed, cancelled, refund attempt, reminder sent, search performed.

nodes.label: Monthly Customers
nodes.rationale: One company can hold 1-50 trucks under one profile; system shows total/active/expired trucks, renewal rate, monthly total (sum of per-truck rates).

nodes.label: Tech Stack
nodes.rationale: Next.js/TypeScript/Tailwind/Framer Motion/Shadcn front; FastAPI/Python/SQLAlchemy/PostgreSQL/Redis/Celery back; JWT + RBAC; Docker/Linux/Nginx.

nodes.label: MTPMS Design System (DESIGN.md)
nodes.rationale: Implemented source of truth (over the CLAUDE.md brief) describing globals.css tokens and the component library; design tooling reads this file.

nodes.label: 60-30-10 Colour System
nodes.rationale: 60% warm ivory, 30% forest green structure, 10% amber for the one primary action + money highlight per view. Breaking the ratio collapses the premium read into a generic dashboard; amber is scarce on purpose.

nodes.label: Ink-Twin Contrast Rule
nodes.rationale: A hue bright enough to FILL a button is never dark enough to BE text on cream, so every fill colour has an -ink twin clearing WCAG AA 4.5:1; use the bright original for fills, the -ink twin when the colour is the words.

nodes.label: Brand Colour Tokens
nodes.rationale: forest-700 #173f35 primary, amber-500 #d6862b accent, cream/ivory surfaces, ivory-100 text on forest; semantic success/danger/warning states.

nodes.label: Inter + JetBrains Mono Typography
nodes.rationale: Inter (self-hosted, deterministic across OSes — SF Pro fell through to Segoe UI) for all text differentiated by weight; JetBrains Mono only for truck-stop data (truck#, plates, receipts, money) with tabular-nums.

nodes.label: Skeuomorphic Surface Classes
nodes.rationale: .card-paper cream ticket, .tile-option segmented selector (selected=forest ring), .panel-steel brushed forest, .btn-embossed physical press; reuse them, don't reinvent a card.

nodes.label: Restrained Motion System
nodes.rationale: .animate-rise page entrance, 160-180ms surface transitions; only animate transform/opacity/box-shadow, never transition:all; every animation needs a prefers-reduced-motion fallback.

nodes.label: Spot-State Colours (lot map / availability)
nodes.rationale: free=success, reserved=forest-700/30 (monthly's held-but-empty spot), occupied=forest-700, expiring=warning, grace=amber, overstay=danger, inactive=black/10; each colour paired with a legend label (no colour-only encoding).

nodes.label: Anti-AI-Slop Guardrails
nodes.rationale: No purple/violet/indigo or blue-purple gradients (the #1 AI-slop tell), no amber sprayed across buttons, no mono for prose, no -apple-system primary face, no uniform bubbly radius, no colour-only status encoding, no text in a bright fill colour.

nodes.label: Accessibility Rules
nodes.rationale: Body text >=16px, contrast >=4.5:1, tabular-nums on numeric columns, 44px touch targets on mobile, visible amber focus ring, both light+dark first-class, respect prefers-reduced-motion.

nodes.label: Auth Stack (python-jose, passlib, bcrypt<4.1)
nodes.rationale: bcrypt pinned <4.1 because passlib 1.7.4 (last release, unmaintained) breaks with bcrypt>=4.1 — its internal backend self-test relies on behavior that changed there.

nodes.label: Stripe SDK (vestigial dependency)
nodes.rationale: stripe>=11.1 still listed though the plaza is staff-only and processes no cards online; the STRIPE_* env vars are ignored and stay blank.

nodes.label: Production Docker Compose Stack
nodes.rationale: The whole plaza in one command; five (+certbot) services with every secret in .env.prod.

nodes.label: Backend Service (FastAPI, self-migrating)
nodes.rationale: One uvicorn worker on purpose (in-process rate limiting); runs its own Alembic migrations at startup; DOCS_ENABLED=false in prod.

nodes.label: Frontend Service (Next.js)
nodes.rationale: NEXT_PUBLIC_API_URL baked into the browser bundle at build time as same-origin paths; nginx routes /api to backend so no cross-origin round trips.

nodes.label: Nginx Reverse Proxy (only published port)
nodes.rationale: Only published port (80/443); routes /api to backend, rest to frontend; reloads every 6h to pick up renewed certs; NGINX_CONF flips to nginx-tls.conf once a cert exists.

nodes.label: Cron Nightly Backup Service
nodes.rationale: One tiny always-on loop instead of host cron; nightly pg_dump into ./backups bind mount (on HOST disk), keeps 14 days.

nodes.label: Certbot TLS Renewal Service
nodes.rationale: Runs only with --profile tls; renews twice a day (certbot acts when <30 days remain); first cert is a one-shot docker compose run pinned with --cert-name mtpms.

nodes.label: Fixed JWT_SECRET Rationale
nodes.rationale: JWT_SECRET is fixed and explicit in .env.prod because a generated-per-container secret would log every user out on each restart and never survive a rebuild.

nodes.label: Docker Self-Hosted Deploy Guide
nodes.rationale: Entire system runs from one docker compose command on any machine with Docker; first-visit creates the admin account, further registrations locked.

nodes.label: RBAC Roles (attendant/manager/admin)
nodes.rationale: attendant=front desk (passes, lot check, find a truck); manager=+money (dashboard, payments, reports, insights); admin=+staff accounts and audit log. Enforced at the API, mirrored in the sidebar.

nodes.label: Spot Inventory Config (PARKING_CAPACITY, SPOT_GRACE_DAYS, SPOTS_PER_ZONE)
nodes.rationale: Spot inventory is config: capacity sizes the painted lot (a 300-spot client is an env var, not code); free/occupied is DERIVED from live passes with no status column and no midnight job.

nodes.label: Plaza Timezone Config (America/Detroit)
nodes.rationale: Every 'today' (revenue, expiry, renewals) is computed in the plaza timezone, never the host's; on Postgres the session timezone is pinned to it too.

nodes.label: Alembic Self-Migration at Startup
nodes.rationale: Schema = Alembic only; backend upgrades itself to head at startup and pre-Alembic databases are detected and stamped once.

nodes.label: Staff-Only, No Stripe Payments
nodes.rationale: As of 2026-08 the plaza is STAFF-ONLY: no customer kiosk, no online card processing. The cashier records cash/credit/debit/check at the desk. No Stripe steps; STRIPE_* env vars are ignored.

nodes.label: TLS via Certbot / Let's Encrypt
nodes.rationale: Obtain the first cert one-shot via webroot, flip NGINX_CONF=nginx-tls.conf; rebuild required because the frontend bakes PUBLIC_BASE_URL into the browser bundle.

nodes.label: Nightly pg_dump Backups
nodes.rationale: Backups land in ./backups on the host; copy them OFF the box since a backup on the same disk survives mistakes, not hardware.

nodes.label: Free Hosting Guide (Vercel+Render+Neon)
nodes.rationale: $0/month browser-only path to put the app online with no domain; the client gets the Vercel link. Caveat: the Render engine sleeps after ~15 min idle (first visit ~30-60s to wake); data lives safely in Neon.

nodes.label: Cross-Service Env Wiring
nodes.rationale: Render gets DATABASE_URL (Neon), PUBLIC_BASE_URL + CORS_ORIGINS (Vercel URL); Vercel gets NEXT_PUBLIC_API_URL (Render URL). The engine only accepts the website once told the website's address; changing an env var requires redeploy.

nodes.label: Render Blueprint (render.yaml)
nodes.rationale: Render reads render.yaml to create the service; three values (DATABASE_URL, PUBLIC_BASE_URL, CORS_ORIGINS) pasted in the dashboard afterward per DEPLOY-FREE.md.

nodes.label: mtpms-backend Web Service
nodes.rationale: Free python web service, rootDir backend, buildCommand pip install -r requirements.txt, startCommand uvicorn app.main:app with --proxy-headers so rate limiters see the real client IP; healthCheckPath /api/health; JWT_SECRET generateValue; SPOTS_PER_ZONE=40.

nodes.label: Next.js Agent Rules Block
nodes.rationale: Auto-written/re-added by next dev; warns this Next.js may differ from training data (read node_modules/next/dist/docs). Committing it with your work keeps the tree clean.

nodes.label: Amber Box-Truck Favicon on Forest
nodes.rationale: App favicon: a rounded forest-green (#173F35) square holding an amber (#D6862B) box-truck silhouette (cargo box + sloped-hood cab) with two amber wheels that have forest hubs. A skeuomorphic truck-stop brand mark in the exact brand palette.

nodes.label: Zone Availability Implementation Plan
nodes.rationale: TDD build plan (6 tasks) for zone labels, live board, and move override, all additive on the tested spot engine which must NOT change; spot_label is backend-authoritative, move is login-gated.

nodes.label: byZone Grouping Helper
nodes.rationale: frontend/src/lib/zones.ts groups the flat lot into ordered zone blocks by the letter in each spot label, with a free count per zone.

nodes.label: Zone Availability Design Spec
nodes.rationale: Client is Madco itself: 150 spots painted into 6 zones A-F of 25. Three thin additions on top of the untouched derived-state engine: zone labels, a 5s-polling cashier board, and one move endpoint.

nodes.label: spot_label Zone Label Helper
nodes.rationale: A spot's identity stays its integer number (stable key); spot_label derives a display label 1->A1, 26->B1, 150->F25. Backend-authoritative and exposed on SpotState, PassRead, PassListItem, LotCheckResult, PassVerifyResult so the ticket/verify/lot-check all say 'B14' not '39'.

nodes.label: /availability Live Cashier Board
nodes.rationale: Login-gated route reusing GET /api/spots: spots grouped into 6 zone blocks with per-zone + lot-wide free counts, cells coloured by the existing state palette, auto-refresh every 5s and paused while the tab is hidden.

nodes.label: Move-a-Truck Endpoint (POST /api/spots/move)
nodes.rationale: Login-gated {pass_id,to_number}: verify target active/free/not-overstay under the same lock pick_free_spot uses (else 409), repoint pass.spot_id, stamp old spot last_vacated_at, audit-log it. Free spots only, no truck-to-truck swap in v1.

nodes.label: SPOTS_PER_ZONE Config
nodes.rationale: spots_per_zone:int=25 (env SPOTS_PER_ZONE); 0 disables zoning and falls back to bare numbers. Purely a display label over the integer spot number.

nodes.label: Lot Organization + Reserved Spots Spec
nodes.rationale: Agreed design, not built (adds a DB migration), cut on top of the noon/renewal branch. Organizes the lot by pass type and gives monthly trucks a fixed reserved spot instead of grab-the-longest-empty.

nodes.label: Zone Split (A monthly / B-F daily)
nodes.rationale: R1: Zone A (spots 1-25)=monthly area, Zones B-F (26-150)=daily area. A monthly overflow spills to the nearest open daily spot and reserves it too; never refuse.

nodes.label: Spot.reserved_vehicle_id Column
nodes.rationale: New nullable FK -> vehicles.id (Alembic migration). Non-null means the spot is reserved to that truck and out of the daily pool; the minimum stored fact for 'held even while empty.' Additive nullable column, safe on the live spots table.

nodes.label: Reservation-Aware pick_free_spot
nodes.rationale: Becomes type+reservation aware: monthly reuses its reserved spot (renewals never move) or takes the lowest free monthly spot then spills; daily/weekly take nearest-longest-vacant among daily non-reserved spots. Free-spot queries exclude reserved spots.

nodes.label: MONTHLY_ZONE_COUNT Config
nodes.rationale: Setting (default 1) controlling how many leading zones are monthly; bumping to 2 makes A+B monthly with one config change.

nodes.label: Reserved Board State
nodes.rationale: R6: a spot reserved to a monthly truck currently OUT shows a new 'reserved' colour (not green free) so a cashier never sells it by accident; reserved + truck present = occupied as normal.

nodes.label: Release Reservation on Close-Out
nodes.rationale: R3: reservation persists until the customer is closed out (close-out renewal mode -> MonthlyCustomer inactive), NOT when a pass expires. A lapsed monthly keeps their spot waiting. This supersedes the SPOT_GRACE_DAYS auto-release for monthlies.

nodes.label: Pass Expiry + Renewal Design Spec
nodes.rationale: Agreed spec, not built. Fixes two things: late renewals wrongly renewing from today, and daily passes needing a noon (hotel-checkout) expiry.

nodes.label: Daily Noon Expiry (R1)
nodes.rationale: A daily pass is valid until 12:00 PM plaza time on its end date, then Expired and its spot frees (resellable that afternoon). Pricing unchanged ($20 x days). Noon is daily-only; weekly/monthly keep midnight/date expiry.

nodes.label: Renewal Anchored to Old End Date (R2)
nodes.rationale: A renewal always starts from the old pass's end date, never 'today,' even when the customer is late — remove the max(today, expiration) floor so a loyal customer doesn't lose the days his spot was held.
nodes.norm_label: renewal anchored to old end date (r2)

nodes.label: Continue vs Close-Out Renewal Modes (R3)
nodes.rationale: Continue (staying): charge whole periods from the old end that carry past today. Close-out (leaving): charge whole periods + extra days at the daily rate ($20/day) up to his leaving day, then set the monthly customer inactive.

nodes.label: pass_expired() Central Helper
nodes.rationale: expiration_date stays a date; a central pass_expired(pass_type, expiration_date, now) routes every expiry/spot decision (live_status, spot derivation, lot-check, verify, dashboard, list, morning report). Largest ripple: the spot engine must free a daily spot at noon.

nodes.label: renewal_quote Pricing Logic
nodes.rationale: renewal_start = parking_pass.expiration_date (drop max(today,...)); add mode:continue|close_out to RenewPassRequest and branch for end-date default + price. Owner never calculates: the Renew screen auto-pre-fills dates and price.
